name: kapom-promptpack
description: Pack the files you care about into a single markdown prompt, ready to paste into AiPASS, ChatGPT, Claude, or any other AI chat.
author: Kapom (https://github.com/vimpys)

kapomPromptPack.includeExtensions.markdownDescription: File extensions to include, without the dot. An empty list allows every extension.

kapomPromptPack.ignorePatterns.markdownDescription: Names or globs to skip. Matched against each path segment, so `dist` also skips `packages/app/dist`.

kapomPromptPack.respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Skip files the workspace's `.gitignore` already excludes.

kapomPromptPack.maxFileSizeKb.markdownDescription: Skip files larger than this. `0` disables the limit.

kapomPromptPack.tokenWarningThreshold.markdownDescription: Warn when the estimated payload passes this many tokens. `0` disables the warning.

kapomPromptPack.includeProjectOverview.markdownDescription: Add the workspace name, file count and token estimate at the top of the prompt.

kapomPromptPack.secretGuard.enabled.markdownDescription: Scan file contents for credentials. **Files whose names look like secrets — `.env`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `credentials*` — are skipped either way; that cannot be turned off.**

markdownEnumDescriptions: Mask the offending values and keep the rest of the file.
Leave out any file that contains a credential.
kapomPromptPack.secretGuard.mode.markdownDescription: What to do when a credential is found inside a file.

kapomPromptPack.secretGuard.extraPattern.markdownDescription: Extra regular expressions to redact. A capture group marks the part to mask; without one the whole match is masked.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Always open the prompt for review first.
Open it when the payload is large, or when something was redacted or skipped.
kapomPromptPack.previewBeforeCopy.markdownDescription: Show the assembled prompt before it reaches the clipboard. Once pasted, it cannot be recalled.

kapomPromptPack.scrubAbsolutePaths.markdownDescription: Replace absolute paths inside file contents, so the account name in `C:\Users\<name>` does not travel with the prompt.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Thai headings in the generated prompt.
English headings in the generated prompt.
kapomPromptPack.outputLanguage.markdownDescription: Language of the headings in the generated prompt.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ext
